'''Timothy Peterson''' (also published as '''Tim Peterson''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 22nd at [[2001 Normal DPC]] on 24 February 2001, according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ normal-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Timothy Peterson also played at [[2000 North American Continental Championship]] on 11 August 2000 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Clint Hays's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1181">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-30-gencon-and-the-sea-of-jizzd1181/ gencon-and-the-sea-of-jizz], DeckTech (Clint "GameMaster" Hays, 30 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-30-gencon-and-the-sea-of-jizzd1181/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
